text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the temporary conclusion 
of our Shuntaisai training camp.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
――Trainer. 
I really love the way Soaring Gallop makes 
me move.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I take a deep breath, replacing every bit 
of air in my body. 
Then I stretch my whole body oooout, 
feeling so totally refreshed and loose...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... and I'm totally nailing the next 
one, too!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Lady Blast's movements have improved 
beyond recognition, haven't they?

text_block_list.name: Soaring Gallop Preservation Society President
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. 
Entrusting this to Tsunade-san was truly 
the right choice.

text_block_list.name: Soaring Gallop Preservation Society President
text_block_list.text:
Soaring Gallop is a sacred rite shared 
between horsegirl and human. 
A horsegirl grows for the sake of the 
person standing by her side.

text_block_list.name: Soaring Gallop Preservation Society President
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Just like back then, when I leapt 
with everything I had 
for the sake of the person who was my 
partner.

text_block_list.name: Soaring Gallop Preservation Society President
text_block_list.text:
――I believe Blast-san will deliver the 
finest performance yet. 
Drawing strength from the gleam in that 
person's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Well, I can't let myself fall 
behind! 
――Come now, let us practice!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer camp draws to a close, giving 
way to autumn. 
There are four months left until the 
progress presentation in late December.
